dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good evening. Can I help you?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd ˈiːvnɪŋ. kən aɪ ˈhɛlp juː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. My bag didn't arrive. I was on the flight from Osaka.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. maɪ ˈbæɡ ˈdɪdənt əˈraɪv. aɪ wʌz ɑːn ðə ˈflaɪt frəm oʊˈsɑːkə.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'm sorry. Was your flight delayed?
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈsɑːri. wʌz jʊr ˈflaɪt dɪˈleɪd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, for three hours. And while we were waiting, they changed the gate.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, fər ˈθriː ˈaʊərz. ənd waɪl wiː wɜːr ˈweɪtɪŋ, ðeɪ ˈtʃeɪndʒd ðə ˈɡeɪt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Oh. Did you hear the announcement?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ. dɪd juː ˈhɪr ði əˈnaʊnsmənt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No. I was buying a drink while they were making the announcement!
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ. aɪ wʌz ˈbaɪɪŋ ə ˈdrɪŋk waɪl ðeɪ wɜːr ˈmeɪkɪŋ ði əˈnaʊnsmənt!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Did you board the plane on time?
dialogue.reading: dɪd juː ˈbɔːrd ðə ˈpleɪn ɑːn ˈtaɪm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. When I got to the new gate, the passengers were waiting in line to board.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. wɛn aɪ ˈɡɑːt tə ðə ˈnuː ˈɡeɪt, ðə ˈpæsɪndʒərz wɜːr ˈweɪtɪŋ ɪn ˈlaɪn tə ˈbɔːrd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Then maybe your bag missed the flight. Can I see your boarding pass, please?
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈmeɪbi jʊr ˈbæɡ ˈmɪst ðə ˈflaɪt. kən aɪ ˈsiː jʊr ˈbɔːrdɪŋ ˌpæs, ˈpliːz?
